## Screenshots

For user-visible changes, install the PR's Simulator app (`scripts/simulator-app.sh PR_NUMBER`) on a simulator, capture the changed screens and attach them with `gh pr comment PR_NUMBER --attach` (from a fork without push access, drop the images into a comment in the browser instead). Non-UI changes can remove this section.
